The '''Corsair Raider''' was a torpedo-shaped [[Gunship/Legends|gunship]] that could carry several crewmembers and gunners. They were operated by the [[Corsairs]] of the western canyons on the planet [[Exocron]]. Capable of speeds up to two hundred [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometers]] an hour, each Raider was armed with a [[projectile cannon]], four [[percussion cannon]]s, and twelve [[Missile/Legends|air-to-air rockets]].
